title: SIA issues guidance on ALPR use
summary: The Security Industry Association (SIA) issued policy principles and guidance for the responsible use of automated license plate reader (ALPR) technology, aimed at informing state and federal legislative and administrative action. The guidance addresses constitutional protections, warrantless use concerns, misuse safeguards, and law enforcement policy, and comes amid growing scrutiny of ALPRs including controversy around Flock Safety.

key_quotes.quote: ALPR is not - and must never become - a tool for mass surveillance or tracking law-abiding citizens.
The guidance comes as automated license plate reader technology faces growing scrutiny nationwide, driven in part by controversy surrounding Flock Safety, a major provider of ALPR technology.
